item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera connects a straight copper wire to a cell in her classroom and holds a small compass close to the wire. She presses the switch and current flows through the wire.
What happens to the compass needle, and why?

options.A: The needle deflects because the current in the wire produces a magnetic field around the wire
options.B: The needle deflects only after the wire becomes hot
options.C: The needle does not deflect because copper is not a magnetic material
options.D: The needle deflects because the cell attracts the needle directly
